title: SURFACE: Preference Distribution Matching on Pareto Fronts via Scalarization Steering
abstract: arXiv:2611.17484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constructing a finite Pareto representation requires allocating a limited number of solutions across the Pareto front (PF). A desired preference distribution specifies this allocation by assigning more solutions to some PF regions and fewer to others. Scalarization generates Pareto solutions by varying objective weights and solving single-objective problems. However, a distribution of scalarization weights generally does not translate into the same distribution of Pareto solutions along the PF, because the weight-to-solution map is nonlinear and unknown in advance.To account for this distortion, we introduce SURFACE (Scalarization Updates for Redistributing Finite Approximations with Chart Estimation}), which adaptively updates scalarization weights to match a desired PF distribution. SURFACE estimates how each region of the weight grid corresponds to an area of the PF from the current scalarized solutions, then redistributes the weights

translated_title: SURFACE：通过标量化引导实现帕累托前沿上的偏好分布匹配
translated_abstract: 构建有限帕累托表示需要在帕累托前沿（PF）上分配有限数量的解。期望的偏好分布通过在某些PF区域分配更多解、在其他区域分配较少解来规定这种分配方式。标量化方法通过改变目标权重并求解单目标问题来生成帕累托解。然而，标量化权重的分布通常无法转化为PF上相同的帕累托解分布，因为权重到解的映射是非线性的且事先未知。为了应对这种失真，我们提出了SURFACE（基于图表估计的标量化更新以重新分配有限逼近方法），它能够自适应地更新标量化权重以匹配期望的PF分布。SURFACE从当前的标量化解中估计权重网格的每个区域如何对应于PF的相应区域，然后重新分配权重……
tldr: 提出SURFACE方法，通过估计权重网格与帕累托前沿区域的对应关系并自适应更新标量化权重，使有限数量的帕累托解能够匹配期望的偏好分布。
en_tdlr: SURFACE adaptively updates scalarization weights by estimating the correspondence between weight grid regions and Pareto front areas, enabling a finite set of Pareto solutions to match a desired preference distribution.
